title: Final Charge Density
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the induced charge density on the conductor.

title: Image Dipole Concept
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly identify and utilize the concept of the image dipole in their solution.

title: Potential Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive the potential due to both the dipole and its image correctly.

title: Partial Derivative
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly compute the partial derivative of the potential with respect to z.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign mistakes when calculating the induced charge density.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that units are consistent throughout their calculations.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria: The student could discuss limiting cases or special scenarios to validate their results.
